_PORT_TODO_systemWeb: system.web compilation/httpRuntime/pages sections are not honored on ASP.NET Core and have been removed. customErrors replaced by exception-handling middleware.
_PORT_TODO_defaultDocument: system.webServer defaultDocument was set to Default.aspx. In Blazor Server the root route is handled by the Blazor router — no defaultDocument needed.
_PORT_TODO_flatKeyConsumers: Previous code read settings as flat keys (e.g. ConfigurationManager.AppSettings["Bedrock.Region"]). Now structured as sections (e.g. Bedrock:Region). Update all consumers to use IOptions<DatabaseOptions>, IOptions<BedrockOptions>, IOptions<StorageOptions> and register these in Program.cs via builder.Services.Configure<T>(builder.Configuration.GetSection("...")).
